tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind everything; carries the dot grid (`.ik-canvas`).

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: The dots of the canvas grid only. Decorative — never text or borders.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: comment threads, media controls, inputs, secondary buttons. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a paper surface (between comments). Never the outer border of a component — that is outline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and display numerals on canvas, paper and every pastel (12:1 or more light, 10.6:1 or more dark); label of every outlined button. Light in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ink-filled controls (a pressed resolve toggle). paper text on it is 13.7:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: caps labels, author names, timestamps, hints. 4.9:1 or better (light) and 5.6:1 or better (dark) on canvas, paper and all pastels.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The signature thick border on cards, inputs, buttons and the media bar, drawn at stroke-bold. Light: ink. Dark: ink at half brightness (#7a7874), 4.1:1 against canvas and 3.8:1 against paper, so edges stay clear without glaring.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Pastel fill for cards, stat tiles, tags, avatars. Ink or ink-muted text.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Pastel fill for cards, stat tiles, tags, avatars. Ink or ink-muted text.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Pastel fill for cards, stat tiles, tags, avatars. Ink or ink-muted text.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Default avatar fill; also a quiet pastel for tags and cards. Ink text.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Avatar and tag fill, a lighter cousin of sage. Ink text.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Neutral pastel: default tag, hover fill of secondary and ghost buttons, disabled input fill.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: The accent. Played progress, accent button fill, selected states. A fill only: 3:1 or better on canvas and paper as a graphic in both themes; put ink text on it (5.5:1 light, 4.6:1 dark), never paper.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Rose as text: links and rose-colored labels. 5.2:1 or better (light) and 6:1 or better (dark) on canvas, paper and pastels.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Warm secondary accent for an assistant or system voice (its avatar, its badge). A fill only, with ink on it (6.5:1 light, 4.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: mention
tokens.usage: Background of an @mention chip.

tokens.name: mention-ink
tokens.usage: Text of an @mention chip, on mention (7.6:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button: soft pastel blue in light, deep blue in dark, with an ink label (14.9:1 light, 9.8:1 dark) and ink outline.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill; ink label stays 8:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the border of an invalid input, on canvas, paper or danger-soft (5.7:1 or better in both themes). Always paired with a message.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error notice, with danger or ink text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Strong blue focus color: the single border of a focused input, and the 2px ring (2px offset) on buttons and other controls. 4.9:1 or better on every surface and pastel in both themes.

families.serif: ui-serif, "New York", "Iowan Old Style", Charter, "Bitstream Charter", Georgia, serif
families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero numbers and page titles on marketing or empty states. One per view.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Stat tile values and section openers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Comment bodies and short, conversational copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop a file to start a review.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Author names, timestamps, panel titles like "Comment"; in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: ALL-CAPS field and stat labels; set text-transform: uppercase; ink-muted.

styles.name: filename
styles.usage: File names and captions above a framed card.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between avatar and name; caption to frame.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding inline; gap between comments.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding inline; small card padding; gap between stacked tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dot-grid pitch; comment thread padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card padding; gutter between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large card padding; gap between page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and @mention chips.

tokens.name: radius-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small (32px) buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Medium (40px) buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-control-lg
tokens.usage: Large (48px) buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, comment threads, the media bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress segments, avatars, round icon buttons.

stroke.note: Inkline is drawn with a pen: borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: The outline of every card, input, button and the media bar.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Small marks: tags, avatars, progress segments, the resolve button.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers in line color inside a surface.

shadow.note: Flat by default. The one shadow is a hard ink offset used as a hover lift.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover on cards and stat tiles only; a hard offset in the outline color; pair with translateY(-2px). Never on buttons.
